📖 How to use

❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What is the distance formula?
The Pythagorean theorem extended: d = √(Δx² + Δy²) in 2D, plus Δz² in 3D.
Why show distance squared?
It avoids the square root — useful in code and comparisons where only relative distances matter.
Can coordinates be negative?
Yes, differences are squared so the sign of each coordinate doesn’t matter.
